evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and adds a new RPC command `getnetmsgstats` in src/rpc/net.cpp.
rationale: Adds `getnetmsgstats` to provide lifetime aggregate network traffic statistics grouped by message and connection type. This resolves issue #26337 and simplifies traffic tracking for node monitoring tools without continuous `getpeerinfo` polling, though it remains a deferrable diagnostic feature.
